changeSet.sql: do $$ declare r record; begin -- ограничения (индекс ограничения переименовывается вместе с ним) for r in select c.conname as name, t.relname as tbl from pg_constraint c join pg_class t on t.oid = c.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = t.relnamespace where n.nspname = '${schema}' and c.conname like 'demo\_%' loop execute format('alter table %I.%I rename constraint %I to %I', '${schema}', r.tbl, r.name, case when r.name like 'demo\_import\_batch%' then 'manual_upload_batch' || substr(r.name, 18) when r.name like 'demo\_factoring\_package%' or r.name like 'demo\_risk\_signal%' then 'imitation_' || substr(r.name, 6) else 'manual_upload_' || substr(r.name, 6) end); end loop; -- остальные индексы, последовательности identity и сами таблицы for r in select cl.relname as name, cl.relkind as kind from pg_class cl join pg_namespace n on n.oid = cl.relnamespace where n.nspname = '${schema}' and cl.relname like 'demo\_%' and cl.relkind in ('i', 'S', 'r') loop execute format('alter %s %I.%I rename to %I', case r.kind when 'i' then 'index' when 'S' then 'sequence' else 'table' end, '${schema}', r.name, case when r.name like 'demo\_import\_batch%' then 'manual_upload_batch' || substr(r.name, 18) when r.name like 'demo\_factoring\_package%' or r.name like 'demo\_risk\_signal%' then 'imitation_' || substr(r.name, 6) else 'manual_upload_' || substr(r.name, 6) end); end loop; end $$; comment on table "${schema}".manual_upload_batch is 'Факт ручной загрузки: выгрузка генератора, events.csv или партии ML-команды';
